categories.main_business_segments: Beijing New Building Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three segments: lightweight building materials (including gypsum boards and steel studs), waterproof building materials, and coatings. The company focuses on manufacturing and sales of gypsum boards, steel studs, waterproof materials, and architectural and industrial coatings. It also engages in construction services related to waterproofing and provides integrated building material solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced production technologies including clean energy substitution, digital and intelligent manufacturing systems, and patented production processes. It has developed proprietary technologies such as near-zero emission gypsum board production, digital control systems for gypsum board manufacturing, and innovative waterproofing materials like TPO membranes and modified asphalt coatings. The company emphasizes R&D in product functionality, environmental sustainability, and production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include real estate developers, public and commercial building contractors, home decoration companies, and industrial clients. The main markets are commercial and public building decoration, residential construction, and infrastructure projects. The company also serves emerging international markets in Africa, Central Asia, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with a dense sales and distribution network covering northern, southern, and western regions. It has established production bases and subsidiaries in Tanzania, Uzbekistan, Thailand, and Bosnia and Herzegovina, supporting its global expansion strategy targeting emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing New Building Materials operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the building materials supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and sales of finished building materials and related construction services. It sources raw materials such as industrial by-product gypsum and petrochemical products for waterproofing materials but does not operate significantly upstream in raw material extraction.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include strengthening its core gypsum board business ('one body'), expanding waterproof and coatings businesses ('two wings'), and accelerating global market penetration. R&D focuses on green, high-end, digital, and internationalized product development, including clean production technologies, functional building materials, and digital manufacturing systems. It actively pursues innovation in sustainable materials and smart factory construction.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of gypsum boards, steel studs, waterproofing materials, and coatings. The company also earns income from construction services related to waterproofing projects and from licensing and technology services. Sales are conducted mainly via a broad network of distributors and direct sales to large customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds the leading market position in China’s gypsum board industry, recognized as the pioneer and largest player domestically. It competes with international and domestic manufacturers producing high-end, mid-range, and low-end products. Its strong brand portfolio including 'Longpai' and 'Taishan' gypsum boards, and comprehensive product solutions provide competitive advantages over peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 22.43 billion, a year-on-year increase of 11.27%, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.52 billion, up 12.07%. It maintains a robust financial scale with total assets exceeding RMB 30 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion, demonstrating steady growth and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes green technology and quality living as its mission, offering environmentally friendly, energy-efficient, and high-performance building materials. Its product differentiation lies in advanced manufacturing technologies, comprehensive product lines tailored to diverse customer needs, and integrated service solutions. The company’s strong brand reputation, extensive distribution network, and commitment to innovation underpin its competitive edge.
